settings.profiles.title: Property profiles
settings.profiles.intro: Profiles define property fields centrally: name, type, fixed value range and default value. Profiles are Markdown files in the profile folder; documents assign themselves via the assignment field, the default profile applies to all files of the area.
settings.profiles.noArea: Property profiles are only available in windows with an area.
settings.profiles.folderPlaceholder: Folder relative to the area root, e.g. Profiles
settings.profiles.bindingsHint: A document can also find its profile through a tag or its folder. Resolution order is: assignment field, tag, folder, default profile; the paths add to each other, and for the same field name the first match wins. A folder includes its subfolders. Separate multiple entries with commas.
settings.profiles.bindingsEmpty: No assignment by tag or folder set up yet.
settings.profiles.listHint: The list shows the applied state of the area file; changes above take effect after applying.
settings.profiles.listEmpty: No profile files in the configured folder.
settings.profiles.folderMissing: The configured profile folder was not found.
settings.profiles.areaWriteFailed: The area file could not be written (a defective area file is never overwritten).
settings.profiles.error.yaml: YAML error in the frontmatter — the profile provides no definitions.
settings.profiles.error.entry: {ort}: not a valid entry; an object with name is expected.
settings.profiles.error.name: {ort}: field name missing; name is the only required property.
settings.profiles.error.duplicate: {ort}: duplicate field name; name must be unique per level.
settings.profiles.error.multipleType: {ort}: this type does not carry multiple values; possible is one of {expected}.
settings.profiles.error.values: {ort}: invalid value list; expected a list of simple values matching the type.
settings.profiles.error.default: {ort}: default value does not match the type; expected a value of type {expected}.
settings.profiles.error.defaultOutsideVa: {ort}: default value outside the value range; allowed is one of {expected}.
settings.profiles.error.icon: icon must be exactly one character (an emoji, for example); the entry is dropped, the profile remains.
settings.profiles.error.optionUnknown: {ort}: unknown entry in options; for this type {expected} is provided. The entry is dropped, the field remains.
settings.profiles.error.optionValue: {ort}: entry in options has an unsuitable value; expected is {expected}. The entry is dropped, the field remains.
settings.profiles.error.valuesFromConfli: {ort}: values and valuesFrom at the same time; values applies, valuesFrom is dropped.
settings.profiles.error.derivedNoValues: {ort}: a derived field has no value of its own; the {expected} entry is dropped, the field remains.
settings.profiles.error.extendsCycle: extends forms a cycle (revisited at {name}); the chain ends there.
settings.profiles.error.extendsMissing: extends names a profile that does not exist ({name}); the chain ends there.
settings.profiles.error.extendsMultiple: extends names more than one profile; only the first one applies ({name}).
